game.title: Pittsburgh Steelers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

lede: Pittsburgh Steelers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#17 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Tampa Bay Buccaneers -1.4 with a fair total of 43.8 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Tampa Bay Buccaneers pass offence vs Pittsburgh Steelers pass defence, which sits −0.052 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
